field.label: Name
field.help: Name to identify this SNI route.

field.label: Description
field.help: Optional description for this SNI route.

field.label: Frontend
field.help:
The public frontend that serves these domains. Two modes are supported automatically:
TCP / SSL (passthrough) — the raw TLS handshake is forwarded and routing is by SNI (req.ssl_sni); the passthrough boilerplate (tcp-request inspect-delay / accept on ssl_hello_type) is added for you.
HTTP (TLS terminated here) — the frontend decrypts and routing is by Host header (hdr(host)). Use this when HAProxy holds the certificate; it avoids the HTTP/2 connection-coalescing misrouting that happens with passthrough + a shared wildcard cert.

field.label: Domains (SNI)
field.help: One or more domain names to match against the TLS SNI. Type a name and press enter to add it. For Exact host matching enter the full hostname (e.g. www.example.com); for Subdomains matching enter the parent domain (e.g. example.com) to match any *.example.com.

field.label: Match type
field.help: Exact host matches the SNI verbatim (req.ssl_sni -i). Subdomains matches any host ending in the given domain (req.ssl_sni -m end -i .domain); note it does not match the bare parent domain itself.

field.label: Target backend
field.help: The backend that connections for the matched domains are forwarded to. Create the backend in advance as a TCP-mode pool with the destination server(s); this route only wires the SNI match to it via use_backend.
